intro: Following Ongeku, Uthek the Wise tells you the earth says the Magram are growing weak, and that the hour has come to slay their Khan. Uthek wants the head of Khan Jehn brought to Gelkis Village.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The earth speaks to me, and it says that the Magram grow weak. Now it is time to kill their Khan!
Bring me the head of the Magram Khan, Jehn!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Show me you are a friend of the Gelkis, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Khan Jehn was strong, but stupid. He thought his own strength was great. He did not see that earth magic is stronger. The Magram centaur will now fall without their leader, and the Gelkis will one day rule!
